## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass.
- [ ] A new or changed check has a test where it fires and one where it must stay silent.
- [ ] A rule about a removed Odoo API links to the Odoo source that shows it.
- [ ] Nothing writes to the audited system, and no secret can reach a report.
